cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll reschedule lunch, but I know the order: first a cancellation, then no calls, then you ask for the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've only cancelled lunch. I'm exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Rest tonight. My ex needed rest just before seeing me became another job.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow, then? I'll book our usual table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He chose a restaurant too, so I couldn't beg. Book us a corner; I'll meet you there.

reason: Identify the prior comparator as my ex at A3 so A5 he has an explicit antecedent; retain all events and the same negotiated corner request.
